triples.subject: ClusterHalo
triples.context: We adopt a cluster halo of fixed global mass, which responds self- consistently to the infalling satellite.

triples.subject: ClusterScaleHalo
triples.context: This assumes the cluster poten- tial evolves adiabatically, on long timescales compared to satellite orbital periods, a reasonable approximation for cluster-scale haloes whose late-time growth is dominated by gradual accretion rather than major mergers (Wechsler et al. 2002; Zhao et al. 2003; McBride et al. 2009).
